comments.body: **pm-lead (pm)**: [2026-06-15 18:02] **APPROVED (operator 2026-06-15) — the #12271 (https://github.com/WallyDoodlez/SquidSquad/issues/12271) cutover.** Build with the **shadow/parallel validation** strategy: run progress-based liveness ALONGSIDE PID-liveness first (log what each would decide, alert on divergence), confirm no false-positives/negatives, THEN remove PID-liveness.
